title: RAW_UNREVIEWED: one successor relation shared by two complete passages
summary: Two complete exposed f82r passages would share one abstract successor relation and its argument direction, while their source domains remain different. The test is a whole-passage role and arity constraint, not a singleton gloss for qokeedy or cheey.

target_passages: P1: f82r.1-f82r.9, complete exposed P28 reading N2
P2: f82r.11-f82r.19, complete exposed P28 reading N2
repeated_whole_candidates: qokeedy occurs in both P1 and P2
cheey occurs in both P1 and P2
design.mechanism: A single reusable successor relation is assigned at the whole-form level. Its direction, participant arity, and placement relative to the carried participant are held across P1 and P2; the participant identities themselves may differ by passage.
design.source_owned_constraint: Fibonacci's complete rabbit account separates newly born pairs from pairs eligible to reproduce and then adds consecutive totals (explicitly 1+2 and 144+233=377). Cassius Dio XXXVII.18-19 gives a seven-member planetary succession, a first-hour/day relation, and a 24-hour advance. Both sources require a written successor relation to carry an identified predecessor into a next member; neither licenses target word identities.
design.target_fields_required: The target would need independently visible whole-group boundaries plus a repeated form in the same relation slot, with a recoverable predecessor and successor field in each complete passage. Those identity-bearing fields are currently unknown; no participant role is asserted.
design.contrast: A shared relation/arity contract versus per-passage or per-occurrence reassignment of the repeated forms.
design.prediction: After global renaming of participant labels, one relation table explains the repeated candidate form's direction and arity in both complete passages. Arbitrarily changing the candidate's relation or arity between P1 and P2 breaks the contract even if local word counts remain unchanged.
design.falsifier: No complete target boundary supplies both predecessor and successor fields, or every candidate requires a different direction/arity in P1 and P2, or the fit survives only by assigning each occurrence independently.
closest_closed_predecessors: W97: fixed individual genealogy on f83r, contradicted by self-reference under its identity/pointer contract
GDT969: separate fixed Fibonacci-generated 23-group root-trace/writer, contradicted at INPUT/HIGH code stage
GDT608: directed FORM composition, which does not itself establish a semantic transformer
design.why_distinct: This is a cross-passage invariant of relation direction and arity. It does not assert W97 person identities, GDT969 code, a composition decoder, or the ordered intermediate-state claim in IDEA000406.
design.strongest_likely_failure: The exposed target records may not carry independently known participant or successor fields at all; then a shared relation and arbitrary contextual relabeling are observationally equivalent.
design.meaning_binding_debt: No target meaning is bound. Any later review must retain all groups, test the complete P1/P2 passages jointly, and keep the cohort and ruler readings as incompatible hypotheses rather than evidence for either one.
design.source_limits: The Fibonacci material is the owned Boncompagni 1857 printed witness recorded in AGE_COHORT_POPULATION_SUPPLY.md. The Cassius Dio electronic English presentation is retained with its unproofread-witness limitation in raw_transport_weaving_hours_context_20260920.md. No new target access was used.
